en:
Takamoto, never giving his name,
went to Ankoku-ji again and again
whenever he found the time.



Yet the doubt Takamoto had sensed
never left the garden.

note: Full form since 0.2.12 (caption box sized by text width, limit 288 px): family name and 'Residence' restored; 'Koriyama Castle' is the approved short form used by the other Koriyama captions. 219 px.

en:
A few days later, Yoshitaka's
adopted daughter promptly wed
and became Takamoto's wife.



With his marriage, Takamoto moved
into Okimoto's old residence,
and there he prepared in earnest
to become the next clan head.


Motoharu, meanwhile, formally
entered Ogurayama Castle as
head of the Kikkawa clan.
With Kuchiba Michiyoshi as aide,
the Two Rivers system was at
last complete.
Around this time, great changes
were under way for Matsudaira
Takechiyo, a hostage in Kiyosu,
within the Amago clan of Izumo,
and within the Ouchi of Yamaguchi.

note: Full form since 0.2.12 (caption box sized by text width, limit 288 px): family name and 'Residence' restored; 'Koriyama Castle' is the approved short form used by the other Koriyama captions. 219 px.
Kept the page break before Motonari's muttered reaction as a beat.
What must be complied with is not stated: same event as the marriage talk and the post-coup orders from Sue; kept general ('comply').

en:
Go to the Living Quarters and talk to
Mouri Takamoto
note: Abbreviated Qtrs. to fit 156 px, as in U01624 and U01640. 0.2.14: written in full, since the scene-goal box now fits the English text (the shortened form was for the 8 px per character box).
